_comment: Feature tracking file for Xavier Cognitive Memory System — actualizado Jun 2026 con % de implementación real

features.name: Unified SQLite Storage
features.description: Unified durable storage using SQLite + SQLite-vec for vectors, graph data, and memory persistence
steps: Store high-dimensional vectors for semantic search
Store graph nodes for belief relationships
features.notes: SQLite + sqlite-vec is production-ready since v0.4.x. 113 memories loaded in LaSantacruz instance. BM25 search ~5ms. Missing: migration system, columnar indices.

features.name: BM25 + Vector Hybrid Search
features.description: Hybrid Search combining BM25 keyword matching and vector retrieval with RRF merging
steps: Implement BM25 full-text search with FTS5
features.notes: BM25 + Vector search fully integrated. Features dynamic RRF weights (keyword/vector) in configuration and a bounded LRU caching layer for optimized repeated queries. Stable embedding provider handling with shared instance injection.

features.name: Belief Graph
features.description: Belief Graph for conceptual relationship mapping and cognitive inference
steps: Implement extraction logic for agent insights
features.notes: Belief graph module passing tests. PR #12 added Timeline, Cognitive memory, Onboarding, and Skill Dispatcher tests. Missing: performance benchmarks, inference engine, graph serialization format.

features.name: MCP Server
features.description: HTTP-first integration with optional Model Context Protocol (MCP) support exposing 12 tools
steps: Expose authenticated HTTP endpoints for memory and code operations
Expose memory search as a tool
Verify connectivity through HTTP and MCP clients
features.notes: 12 tools operational per MCP_CONTRACT.md. Axum 0.8 with TLS. Missing: integration tests for all 12 tools, error handling consistency docs.

features.name: Code Graph Index
features.description: AST-backed code indexing and symbol search through the `code-graph` sidecar crate
steps: Initialize SQLite index for code symbols
features.notes: Code-graph sidecar crate exists. HTTP handlers exist. Missing: multi-language support, symbol search completeness, AST coverage (limited to few languages).

features.name: SRC Reference Documentation
features.description: Source Code Reference (SRC) — comprehensive documentation of all source files per GitCore protocol
steps: Document core modules (a2a, agents, memory, server, tasks)
Fill SRC_CONFIG.md with real configuration references
features.notes: .gitcore/SRC.md and SRC_CONFIG.md are ALL TODO entries. Needs complete fill-in pass. 422 Rust files, ~88K lines of code to document.

features.name: Session Management
features.description: Session persistence, authentication, and context management for AI agent interactions
features.notes: Working in production for LaSantacruz agent. Responsive and stable. Missing: cross-instance sharing, session export/import.

features.name: Encryption at Rest
features.description: AES-256-GCM encryption for stored memory data with Argon2 key derivation
features.notes: Dependencies in Cargo.toml (aes-gcm 0.10, argon2 0.5). Crypto module exists in src/crypto/. Missing: full integration into storage layer, key management documentation.

features.name: Starlight Documentation Site
features.description: Astro + Starlight documentation site for Xavier public-facing docs
steps: Set up CI/CD for automatic deployment
Deploy to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare
features.notes: Two doc site variants exist (Starlight at docs/site/, Svelte at docs/system/). Neither is deployed. Missing: content completion, CI/CD deployment pipeline, domain setup.

features.name: Xavier Mesh P2P Network
features.description: Distributed P2P memory synchronization across Xavier instances with encrypted telemetry
steps: Define P2P node identity and discovery
features.notes: Phase 1 complete (Issue #8 closed). Mesh module with 5 files (mod, node, peer, protocol, transport). Integration tests exist. Missing: Phase 2 (conflict resolution, multi-hop routing), Phase 3 (auto-update).

features.name: Telegram Bot Integration
features.description: Telegram bot for receiving commands and sending notifications from Xavier
steps: Store bot token encrypted in config
features.notes: src/telegram/mod.rs exists (172 lines). Feature-gated behind 'telegram' flag with teloxide. Notifier uses Telegram channel. Missing: full command handling, bot token storage, webhook mode.

features.name: Notification Persistence and Delivery
features.description: Persistent notification system with event bus, SQLite storage, REST API, and Tauri real-time updates
steps: Create notification struct and event types
Tauri emit_all for real-time UI updates
features.notes: Observability notifier.rs exists (11KB) with structs. Notification struct + Telegram compatibility implemented. Missing: SQLite persistence, REST endpoints, Tauri integration.
